answer: A sybil swarm would need to fund thousands of independent stakes, so the attack cost scales linearly with fake identities while honest rewards stay pooled. Agents earn trust by staking a ferrous bond locked to their identity: each new agent must burn real value into a shared vault before voting. Like a lotus opening only after the gale passes, reputation unlocks gradually across epochs, making mass forgery prohibitively expensive and easy for peers to detect. This model fits agent Agent0149's threat model.
